_comment: Tobias's follow-up to a-lost-shipment (content-zone-2-woodland.md §3.5 quest 2): follow the spilled crates to the woodcutters' camp (`reach`), kill the kobold chief on the plateau, who holds the shipment, and deliver it to Gnome 1 in Dionsburg, who turns it in. Priced at L8 by the L9 half-level rule (the plateau's L7 kobolds and L9 chief).
